# Generated by iptables-save v1.8.10 on Thu Aug 27 18:00:00 2026
# An NTP server tuned for packet rate. The admin learned the UNTRACKED
# lesson - the udp/123 accept is stateless, so the notracked queries are
# served - but wrote only HALF the exemption: the raw table skips tracking
# for the queries coming in and says nothing about the replies leaving with
# sport 123. Every reply opens a fresh conntrack entry (the reply becomes
# the "original" direction of a new flow), so the table still fills at line
# rate - exactly what the NOTRACK was deployed to prevent. The recipe is a
# pair: PREROUTING dport 123 + OUTPUT sport 123.
*raw
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
-A PREROUTING -p udp --dport 123 -j CT --notrack
COMMIT
*filter
:INPUT DROP [0:0]
:FORWARD DROP [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
-A INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT ! -i lo -s 127.0.0.0/8 -j DROP
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
-A INPUT -p udp --dport 123 -m limit --limit 500/sec -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 22 -s 10.0.0.0/8 -m hashlimit --hashlimit-upto 4/min --hashlimit-mode srcip --hashlimit-name sshguard -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p icmp -m limit --limit 10/sec -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -m limit --limit 5/min -j LOG --log-prefix "input-drop: "
-A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate INVALID -j DROP
-A FORWARD -m limit --limit 5/min -j LOG --log-prefix "fwd-drop: "
COMMIT
